description: The plot illustrates the relationship between majority voting accuracy and the number of completions (k), with the x-axis representing k on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ and the y-axis showing majority voting accuracy from 0.3 to 0.6. Three distinct lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers starts at approximately 0.43 at k=2⁰, rises steadily to about 0.6 at k=2⁸; a dashed green line with triangular markers begins near 0.43 at k=2⁰, increases more sharply to around 0.6 at k=2⁸; and a dotted light blue line with diamond markers starts at roughly 0.28 at k=2⁰, climbs gradually to about 0.44 at k=2⁸. All lines show increasing accuracy with more completions, though at different rates and starting points.
